title: It's COMPASlicated: The Messy Relationship between RAI Datasets and Algorithmic Fairness Benchmarks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on racial and systemic biases in criminal justice datasets used for algorithmic fairness benchmarks.
findings: The paper makes no findings related to religion. Its focus is on the complexities, biases (primarily racial), and misuse of Risk Assessment Instrument (RAI) datasets like COMPAS in the context of the criminal justice system and algorithmic fairness research.
